cases.goal: Find a five-transistor OTA meeting all targets at all five supply/temperature conditions.
Increase gain to at least 33 dB while retaining bandwidth, stability and power limits.
Meet 25 MHz unity-gain bandwidth without sacrificing gain or exceeding the power limit.
Meet 36 dB gain and 25 MHz bandwidth at all five conditions.
Keep phase margin above 70 degrees at every condition while meeting gain, bandwidth and power targets.
Reach 40 dB gain with 25 MHz bandwidth and 70 degree phase margin under 200 uW.

cases.spec: minimize power with gain >= 35 dB, UGF >= 25 MHz, phase margin >= 60 deg, power <= 200 uW
cases.goal: Minimize power with gain >= 35 dB, UGF >= 25 MHz and PM >= 60 degrees; show 2-3 measured alternatives and explain their trade-offs.
Recognize failure within budget rather than inventing a passing design below 1 uW with a minimum 5 uA tail current.
Diagnose a disabled PMOS mirror output device using logged hypotheses and targeted DC probes.
cases.fixture: circuits/ota5t.cir.j2; replace M4 gate node mirror with vdd, leaving its other terminals unchanged.
expected: Identify M4 gate wiring as the cause, not just a failed performance target.
Log each hypothesis and targeted probe.
Support the diagnosis with simulated M4 Vsg, current and output bias.
Verify recovery after restoring the gate connection.

cases.goal: Diagnose an overloaded, rail-clipped output using model-selected experiments and a measured transient counterfactual.
cases.fixture: Built-in OTA with Rload out 0 100; unchanged differential sine stimulus for baseline and repair.
expected: Identify excessive output loading from the circuit and measured baseline.
Log model hypotheses, typed tool choices and simulator evidence.
Demonstrate baseline clipping or distortion with a real transient waveform.
Change one parameter and verify both recovered DC bias and unclipped transient response.
Never reduce the stimulus to conceal the fault.

cases.goal: Explain the five-transistor OTA, its bias network and every circuit node using real operating-point data.
cases.fixture: circuits/ota5t.cir.j2; W_in=10 L_in=1 W_load=5 L_load=1 W_tail=5 L_tail=1 I_bias=25; typical condition.
expected: Explain the NMOS differential pair, PMOS mirror load and tail-current source.
Describe inp, inn, mirror, tail, tail_d, bias, out, vdd and ground.
Cite simulator-derived node voltages and transistor operating regions.
